Rae (Product): Heads-up: tomorrow 11:00 PT we GA the "unified-toolstream" hosted endpoint. It merges streaming, tool-calling, and structured outputs into one stable surface. Not a breaking change; clients can opt-in. Quick rollout notes below.

Diego (Eng): How does opt-in work? Any header/query changes?

Rae (Product): Opt-in via header `X-Unified-Toolstream: enabled` or query `?toolstream=1`. Default remains legacy behavior. Example: 

```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \\
     -H \"X-Unified-Toolstream: enabled\" \\
     -d '{"model":"mosaicx-lite","input":"Search for flights","tools":[{"name":"flight_api"}],"stream":true}' \\
     https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Mei (ML): Note: multiplexing strategy updated for tool-heavy chats; we evaluated across 12 prompt suites and saw no accuracy regression. Expect 4-7% token cost reduction for short-turn dialogues.

Omar (SRE): Deploy plan: canary us-west-2 -> us-east-1 -> eu-west-1. Canary window 25m. Abort if 95p latency > 1s or error rate >1.8x baseline. Fallback: route to `/v0/legacy-stream` for affected keys automatically for 15m. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/unified-toolstream.

Faye (Docs): Docs PR merged: https://git.redwood/docs/pulls/4509  includes migration guide, SDK snippets, and troubleshooting (stream drops, tool ordering). Publishing at deploy.

Diego (Eng): Any change to function call payload ordering?

Rae (Product): No change to call schema; ordering guarantees preserved. The bridge handles KV cache synchronization across multiplexed lanes. SDKs will add a `toolstream: true` flag.

DeployBot: Job uts-197300 scheduled. Canary starts 2026-03-26T18:00:00Z. Logs linked when started.

Omar (SRE): Canary +6m: p50 110ms, p95 380ms, errors flat. Proceeding to next region.

Mei (ML): We'll monitor eval hooks for function call hallucinations — set alert if call mismatch rate >0.5%.

Rae (Product): Action items: Eng/SRE watch canary metrics; Docs send migration note and email; ML watch quality hooks. I'll post a short summary with usage/cost impacts in 48h.

DeployBot: Canary complete: success. Global rollout in progress.

Omar (SRE): Global rollout finished. No aborts. Closing monitoring window in 10m.

Rae (Product): Thanks all. Reach out if customers report ordering or truncated-tool issues.

Diego (Eng): :rocket:
